rekordbox's own export.pdb at three moments, for issue #62 (how rekordbox
starts a new playlist_entries page and how it takes a track out of a
playlist). Written by rekordbox on the MacBook, 2026-10-04, onto a stick
formatted for the purpose, from 34 generated tone tracks (pdb reference
kit: a01..d10, nothing anyone owns). Only export.pdb is kept.

1-eight-playlists.pdb    P01..P08, all 34 tracks each: 272 entries on
                         page 18, which has room for 12 more.
2-ninth-playlist.pdb     P09 (all 34) exported as an update: rekordbox
                         put all 34 on page 54, the table's empty
                         candidate.
3-one-entry-removed.pdb  d05 (track 26) taken out of P09 and synced:
                         rekordbox deleted P09's 34 rows and added the
                         33 others again, entry_index 1..33, and listed
                         page 54 on the table's index page (17).
